messages.text: When the phone reconnects, queued photos upload twice. Fix upload deduplication so reconnecting cannot create duplicate photos.
The upload queue now retains the idempotency key across reconnects. The regression test reconnects midway through an upload and checks that only one photo is stored.
Great, open the PR.

baseline_title: Prevent Duplicate Photo Uploads on Reconnect

messages.text: Android pairing gets stuck when the QR token expires while the scanner is open. Let the user request a fresh pairing token without restarting the app.
The scanner now detects expired pairing tokens and offers a fresh QR code. The Android pairing regression passes.
Looks good. Open the PR.
Implement offline search for saved notes. A user on a plane should be able to find a note by words in its body, with no network connection.
Saved note bodies are indexed on the device. Airplane-mode tests find notes by body text without making network requests.
Ship it. Open the PR.
Fix keyboard focus after dismissing the settings modal. Screen reader users currently lose their place; focus should return to the exact button that opened the dialog.
The settings dialog now restores focus to its trigger after Escape, outside click, and the close button. The focus restoration tests pass.
Nice. Open a PR for this.
Stop chat from jumping to the bottom while I am reading older messages. New streamed text should only auto-scroll when I was already at the bottom.
I separated manual scroll position from the streaming follow state. Reading older chat messages no longer jumps when tokens arrive.
Okay, keep going.
Notification preferences changed on desktop never reach mobile. Sync notification settings across devices, including turning notifications back on.
Preference updates now publish to the other device and both enabled and disabled states persist after reconnect. I still need the final regression check.
Run the remaining tests.
Our pull request CI workflow is flaky. A successful job from the previous commit sometimes marks the new commit green. Tie every result and rerun to the current head SHA.
The workflow checks the head SHA before publishing its status and discards results from older commits.
Finish fixing the flaky PR checks and rerun CI.

baseline_title: Tie PR Checks to Current Head SHA
